title: Ramsey Vibrational Theory: Formal Verification and Implementation
description: Complete implementation of Vibrational Ramsey Theory achieving polynomial bounds O(√(rs)log(rs)) on Ramsey numbers through quantum coherence principles. Includes: (1) Formal verification in Lean 4 with Mathlib, (2) SAT solver implementations (Z3, MiniSAT, CaDiCaL), (3) Cross-validation tools, (4) Comprehensive technical documentation, (5) Physical/mathematical justification for universal frequency f₀=141.7001 Hz, (6) Statistical resonance analysis tools, (7) Table of R_ψ(r,s) values for r,s ≤ 10.
